g.text: Figure 6. Memory vs board size — measured process peak above baseline (solid) and DLX analytic estimate (dashed)

text.style: font-size: 7.5px; font-family: 'DejaVu Sans', 'Bitstream Vera Sans', 'Computer Modern Sans Serif', 'Lucida Grande', 'Verdana', 'Geneva', 'Lucid', 'Arial', 'Helvetica', 'Avant Garde', sans-serif; text-anchor: start; fill: #52514e

g.text: Measured: peak working set minus the baseline after loading the fixture (4 KiB pages; small boards sit at the page-granularity floor). The estimate is the size DLX computes before allocating.
